name: StormSale New Conversion to Slack
description: Send a Slack alert when StormSale reports a confirmed conversion.

trigger.stormsale_setup: Register the Catch Hook URL in StormSale Webhook Manager and subscribe to conversion.created.

field_mapping.text: New StormSale conversion {{conversion_id}}: {{amount}} {{currency}} for campaign {{campaign_id}} via affiliate {{affiliate_address}}. Status: {{status}}.

note: This is a configuration blueprint, not an importable Zapier template. Zapier templates must be published through Zapier's platform.
